 Special Collections Crafting: Journal and Zine Making Workshop
 In-Person
 Workshop Location: Special Collections Classroom 251, Bobst Library 
 Join NYU Special Collections for a midday making session, combining book arts techniques and "DIY" paper crafts to support your mind by working with your hands. With a few examples from the archives, we will explore how journals, notebooks, and zines (pronounced "zeens") can be platforms for personal expression, and we'll practice making similar objects. Participants will be guided in both constructing and sewing a single-section journal or notebook and how to craft small-scale zines with collage materials. Supplies will be provided and no experience is necessary. 
 This event is part of the NYU Arts and Impact initiative, in support of the 2026-2027 theme, Health & the Arts.
